memorial-bench-plaques.q: Can I put my own plaque on a council bench?
memorial-bench-plaques.a: Usually not. Most councils only allow plaques through their own dedication scheme, and unofficial plaques may be removed. Contact the council’s parks or bereavement team first.

memorial-bench-plaques.q: How many words fit on a bench plaque?
memorial-bench-plaques.a: It depends on the size. As a guide, a 6 x 4 inch plaque fits 4–5 lines and an 8 x 3 inch plaque 3–4 lines. We’ll always send a proof so you can see the spacing.

memorial-bench-plaques.q: Do the plaques come with screws?
memorial-bench-plaques.a: Yes. Every bench plaque comes with stainless steel screws, so it won’t stain the wood.

memorial-bench-plaques.q: How long does a bench plaque take?

can-i-put-a-plaque-on-a-bench.q: Can I put a plaque on any park bench?
can-i-put-a-plaque-on-a-bench.a: No. Park benches belong to the council, and most only allow plaques through their own dedication scheme. Unofficial plaques are usually removed.

can-i-put-a-plaque-on-a-bench.q: How do I dedicate a bench?
can-i-put-a-plaque-on-a-bench.a: Contact the council or landowner’s parks or bereavement team. They’ll explain locations, costs and how long the dedication lasts.

can-i-put-a-plaque-on-a-bench.q: Can I put a plaque on my own bench?
can-i-put-a-plaque-on-a-bench.a: Yes. If the bench is yours, you can order a plaque directly from us in any size.

bench-plaque-wording-ideas.q: What should I write on a memorial bench plaque?
bench-plaque-wording-ideas.a: Most families choose a name, dates and one short line, such as “In loving memory of” or something about why the place mattered. Keep it to a few lines so the letters are large enough to read from the path.

bench-plaque-wording-ideas.q: How many words fit on a bench plaque?
bench-plaque-wording-ideas.a: It depends on the size. As a guide, a 6 x 4 inch plaque fits 4–5 lines and an 8 x 3 inch plaque 3–4 lines. We’ll always send a proof so you can see the spacing.

bench-plaque-wording-ideas.q: Can I put a poem or verse on a bench plaque?
bench-plaque-wording-ideas.a: Yes, if it’s short. A two-line verse works well; a longer poem needs a bigger plaque and smaller letters. Send us the words and we’ll suggest a size.

bench-plaque-wording-ideas.q: Can I put my dog’s name on a memorial bench plaque?
bench-plaque-wording-ideas.a: Yes, on your own bench or garden bench. On council benches the dedication scheme decides what’s allowed, so check with the parks team first.

bench-plaque-wording-ideas.q: Can you engrave the plaque in Welsh?
bench-plaque-wording-ideas.a: Yes. We regularly engrave in Welsh, English or both, with accents such as ŵ and ŷ.

plaque-fonts.q: Can I choose a different font?
plaque-fonts.a: Yes. We have many more engraving fonts than shown here. Tell us what you’d like and we’ll send a proof.

plaque-fonts.q: Can I mix fonts on one plaque?
plaque-fonts.a: Yes. A script name with Roman or capitals for the other lines is a popular choice.

plaque-fonts.q: Will my plaque look exactly like the preview?
plaque-fonts.a: Very close. The preview uses web fonts that match our engraving fonts, and we always send an exact proof before engraving.

plaque-fonts.q: Which font is easiest to read outdoors?
plaque-fonts.a: Classic Roman and Modern are the clearest from a distance, especially on stainless steel.

award-wording-ideas.q: What should I write on an employee of the year award?
award-wording-ideas.a: Usually your logo, the event (for example “Staff Awards 2026”), the award title and the winner’s name. Add a short line such as the year or “in recognition of outstanding commitment” if there’s room.

award-wording-ideas.q: How much text fits on a glass award?
award-wording-ideas.a: It depends on the award. Every award page shows its engraving area, and as a rule four to six short lines look best. We send a free proof so you can see the layout before anything is engraved.

award-wording-ideas.q: Can every award in a set have different wording?
award-wording-ideas.a: Yes. Most sets keep the same logo and event and change the category and name on each award. Send us a list and we’ll proof each one.
